leads.summary: Open PR #7447's absolute dbus-monitor path bypasses this PR's restored event fixture in the new retry test
leads.consequence: If both PRs merge without updating these new invocations, #7447 sets DBUS_MONITOR to /usr/bin/dbus-monitor by default, while its test patch exports the mock override only in the two older monitor calls. The new retry test's stub inhibitor reaches --inhibited on attempt 4, but the script launches the real dbus-monitor instead of the event-emitting stub: in the usual absence of a real PrepareForSleep event, the test waits indefinitely for an event or fails if the system bus cannot be monitored. Pass DBUS_MONITOR="$mock_bin/dbus-monitor" for the new event-dependent invocation as well (or use one fixture-level override). This is a conditional integration conflict, not a defect when #13176 runs alone.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13176#issuecomment-5823113996), checked at `0c9cb9d`. Both earlier findings are resolved. The EBUSY wording note is only partly addressed. One optional test improvement is new.

**Verified** (isolated mocked fixture, no real logind):

| Earlier finding | `1135a8d` (earlier review) | `0c9cb9d` (now) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edited test file fails | fails at the termination test; retry tests never run with the event mock | whole file passes, alone (5 of 5 runs) and under `test/shell`; fails with the fix reverted and against `1135a8d` | resolved |
| Monitor stderr discarded | lock-helper and `dbus-monitor` stderr: 0 lines on service stderr; `tmp.*` file left after stop | 1 + 1 lines, same as base; no temp file | resolved |
| EBUSY wording | title, comments say EBUSY | code comment says OperationInProgress/EINPROGRESS; title, description and one test name still say EBUSY | partly addressed |

- The long-lived path is again `exec systemd-inhibit ... "$sleep_monitor" --inhibited` with no redirection, so `systemd-inhibit` is the unit's main PID with the monitor as its child. Only the throwaway `systemd-inhibit ... true` probe's output is captured.
- The retry behavior is unchanged: a persistent "already running" error stops after 31 attempts (about 6.1 s) with exit 1, and an unrelated error fails after one call with its message printed once.
- The expected call count of 4 is correct: 2 busy probes, 1 successful probe, then the final `exec`.
- The `tee` suggestion in a later comment applied to the earlier revision's `2>"$inhibit_err"` on the long-lived child. The current head has no such redirection, so it no longer applies.

**Wording note:** logind's error maps to `EINPROGRESS`, but the PR title, the description and the assertion `sleep monitor retries an EBUSY delay inhibit` still say EBUSY. The new comment "keeps systemd-inhibit as PID 1" means the unit's main PID. Behavior depends only on the string match.

**Optional test improvement:** the unrelated-error test checks only a non-zero exit and the printed message, so it also passes if every error is retried. A mutant that drops the `*"is already running"*` check passed the whole test file (in about 6.65 s instead of about 0.55 s). Counting calls in that mock closes the gap. This version passed on this head and failed on the mutant with `attempts: 31`:

```bash
cat >"$mock_bin/systemd-inhibit" <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
echo call >>"${INHIBIT_COUNT_FILE:?}"
echo "Failed to inhibit: Permission denied" >&2
exit 1
SH
chmod +x "$mock_bin/systemd-inhibit"
rm -f "$inhibit_count"

if OMARCHY_PATH="$mock_omarchy" \
  PATH="$mock_bin:$PATH" \
  PRODUCER_PID_FILE="$producer_pid_file" \
  LOCK_LOG="$lock_log" \
  INHIBIT_COUNT_FILE="$inhibit_count" \
  "$sleep_monitor" 2>"$tmpdir/inhibit-fail.err"; then
  fail "sleep monitor still fails unrelated inhibit errors"
fi
grep -Fq "Permission denied" "$tmpdir/inhibit-fail.err" ||
  fail "sleep monitor reports unrelated inhibit errors"
[[ $(wc -l <"$inhibit_count") == 1 ]] ||
  fail "sleep monitor does not retry unrelated inhibit errors" "attempts: $(wc -l <"$inhibit_count")"
pass "sleep monitor still fails unrelated inhibit errors"
```

**Related open PR:** #7447 makes the monitor run `${DBUS_MONITOR:-/usr/bin/dbus-monitor}` and adds `DBUS_MONITOR="$mock_bin/dbus-monitor"` only to the two existing test invocations. If both PRs land, the new retry test's monitor call (test lines 146-151) would start the real `dbus-monitor` instead of the event-emitting mock unless it also sets `DBUS_MONITOR`. Both PRs also append to the end of the same test file. This follows from the two diffs; no merged tree was run.

---

**Test scope:** Fresh follow-up review of `0c9cb9d` against the earlier reviewed head `1135a8d` and the base, plus systemd v262 source for logind, `systemd-inhibit` and restart timing, and the diff of open PR #7447. The monitor script and its test file ran in an isolated sandbox with mocked `systemd-inhibit`, `dbus-monitor` and lock helper; only the sleep-monitor and sleep-lock test files ran under `test/shell`, not the full suite. No real logind, system bus or suspend/resume was used, and whether the roughly 6 s retry budget covers real resume timing was not measured. No CI checks are reported on the head commit.
